name: – Victor Negrescu, Siegfried Mureşan – § 52
title: REPORT on the implementation of the Recovery and Resilience Facility
part_text: Shares the view of the ECA that the FNLC model does not preclude reporting on actual costs; notes that having clear insights on costs also facilitates the work of control and oversight bodies, as well as the EPPO and the European Anti-Fraud Office (OLAF), and enables enhanced public scrutiny;
